rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a flower or a mass of flowers on a fruit tree.

example.english: This mango tree has lots of blossom this year.
example.traditional: 今年呢棵芒果樹開咗好多花。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ni1 fo2 mong1 gwo2 syu6 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the flowering season or period when a plant is in blossom.

example.english: The cherry blossom season only lasts two weeks.
example.jyutping: jing1 faa1 faa1 kei4 dak1 loeng5 go3 sing1 kei4

rows.note: Use this for the figurative period when a person, thing, or development is at its most flourishing.

example.english: That team is in full blossom now, so they are really hard to beat.
example.traditional: 佢哋隊波而家正值全盛期，真係好難打。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi6 bo1 ji4 gaa1 zing3 zik6 cyun4 sing6 kei4 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 daa2

rows.note: Use this for the hopeful sign or promise suggested by the figurative blossom, rather than for the developmental stage itself.

example.english: The economy is recovering, and we can finally see a blossom of hope.
example.traditional: 經濟開始復甦，我哋終於見到曙光喇。
example.jyutping: ging1 zai3 hoi1 ci2 fuk6 sou1 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 gin3 dou2 syu6 gwong1 laa3
